scenarios.title: Loss of radial supply
scenarios.objective: Learner opens CB1; after 300 ms travel the supplied load loses voltage and load power. Feedback follows scan; event chain recorded.
scenarios.completion: CB1 actual open and BUS deenergized and learner reviews low-voltage alarm

scenarios.title: Alternative supply remains
scenarios.objective: Opening CB1 does not deenergize BUS because ALT supplies through GB1; show correct energized paths.

scenarios.title: Accepted command without operation
scenarios.objective: An open command times out at 3000 ms; actual CB1 remains closed and BUS remains supplied; discrepancy alarm recorded.

scenarios.title: Communications loss during switching
scenarios.objective: Opening CB1 changes topology even though observation is frozen. Its original timestamp ages beyond 3000 ms and indication becomes stale/unknown.

scenarios.title: Synthetic unit start, synchronization and load ramp
scenarios.objective: Start the fictional unit, inspect sequence permissives, synchronize and close GB1, ramp a modest MW demand, then unload and stop.

scenarios.title: Synthetic overload and protection trip
scenarios.objective: With a local instructor, inject the fictional overload, observe protection response and lockout, let the cause clear, then reset without automatically restarting.
